name: Perfume
overview: Scripture reveals the significance of perfume both in sacred worship and personal life, emphasizing its role in consecration and delight. In the tabernacle, holy anointing oil and sweet incense were carefully prepared by a skilled perfumer and used daily by Aaron to symbolize God's presence and sanctity (Exodus 30:7, 25, 33). Additionally, perfume is associated with intimacy and joy, as seen in the personal use of myrrh and spices to perfume beds (Proverbs 7:17) and the way ointment and perfume can refresh the heart, paralleling the sweetness of heartfelt counsel from a true friend (Proverbs 27:9). These references collectively highlight perfume as a tangible expression of holiness, worship, and the beauty of godly relationships.
